rca of the issue: Original user-reported bug RCA: both PP_Wallet.topup() and PP_B2CWallet.topup() contained a 'coming-soon intercept' that called the SHARED PP_TopupComingSoon.show() popup BEFORE routing to Shopify. Because the popup module is shared between B2B and B2C, B2B users perceived they were being redirected to the B2C 'binnenkort' screen. Mitigation v60.1.155: intercept calls removed from both wallets; topup() now goes straight to Shopify with the correct segregated note-attribute prefix. NEW deploy-side issue found in this iteration: index.html cache-bust was bumped for pp-wallet-v1.js (line 975) but NOT for pp-b2c-wallet-v1.js (line 977). Reproduction: any B2C end-user whose browser/SW cached pp-b2c-wallet-v1.js at v60.1.154 will continue to execute the OLD code containing the intercept → identical symptom to original bug. Mitigation: one-line cache-bust bump on line 977 + zip rebuild.
